info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan By Disbursement Id-spec
info.description: The Delete Loan Disbursement API allows users to remove a specific disbursement from an existing loan by its unique identifiers. This operation is essential for financial institutions managing loan portfolios to maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with accounting practices. Typically utilized by loan managers and financial analysts, this API helps streamline the process of updating loan details when disbursements are canceled or modified. By specifying both the loan ID and disbursement ID, users can effectively target and delete the correct disbursement entry, ensuring operational efficiency.

delete.description: This operation allows a user to delete a specific disbursement associated with a loan. When executed, the identified disbursement will be permanently removed from the records, ensuring it can no longer be accessed or referenced.

requestBody.description: Request body for the deletion of a specific disbursement associated with the loan. It should contain any necessary identifiers and details required to process the delete operation.

204.description: The disbursement has been successfully deleted.

DeleteLoanByDisbursementIdRequest.description: A request body representation for deleting a specific loan disbursement operation in JSON format.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the response, providing additional information such as IDs and timestamps.

DeleteLoanByDisbursementIdResponse_204.description: Response schema for disbursement operation of a loan, indicating successful deletion.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate requests and responses, helpful for tracing.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing of the request took place.

Metadata.description: Contains metadata information regarding the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The application runtime context in which the operation was executed.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer authentication, which requires a JWT (JSON Web Token) to be included in the Authorization header of HTTP requests. The token is typically generated after a successful user authentication and is used to authorize subsequent requests.
